case_name: Concurrency: Goroutine Leak on Context Cancellation

subject_result.rationale: The review perfectly met all rubric requirements. It accurately identified the goroutine leak caused by the unbuffered channel when ctx.Done() fires first, explained the mechanics clearly, and recommended both solutions mentioned in the rubric: buffering the channel (`make(chan fetchResult, 1)`) and propagating the context to the underlying backend call.
findings: Accurately identified the goroutine leak on ctx.Done() due to an unbuffered channel.
Recommended using a buffered channel with capacity 1 as a fix.
Suggested propagating context.Context into the backend FetchRecord method to truly abort underlying work.
Provided additional valuable insights, such as checking ctx.Err() early and testing with goleak.
